result.description: A fictional desktop display designed for immersive creative work and everyday productivity, the Nebula Arc 27Q combines a 27-inch QD-OLED panel with 2560 x 1440 resolution, 240 Hz refresh, and 0.03 ms response time. It includes DisplayPort 1.4, dual HDMI 2.1 inputs, a fully adjustable stand, and wide-gamut color tuning for illustration, motion graphics, and games. The monitor supports HDR10, USB-C with 90 W power delivery, and a low-blue-light mode for extended sessions.
